runners.comment: Pulled up twice towards end of 2025 and needs three-month break to have done him good
runners.name: Disco Davis
runners.spotlight: Good fourth on seasonal debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) but ought to have been suited by the soft ground when pulled up on consecutive outings towards end of last year (2m4f/2m6f); tries a new trip here; needs three-month break to have done him good.

runners.comment: Consistent front-runner; recently ended a losing streak; still unexposed as a stayer
runners.name: Inferno Sacree
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who has been consistent this season and ended a long losing streak at Taunton (3m, good to soft) 11 days ago; went up 5lb for that but this track also suits him and he remains unexposed as a stayer.

runners.breeder: Mrs Marie Merienne & Mr Julien Merienne
runners.comment: 2-6 over hurdles; never dangerous when fifth at Ascot last time but this race is easier
runners.name: Confinentic
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner (2m/2m4f); never looked dangerous when fifth of 18 at Ascot (2m7f, good to soft) last month but wasn't beaten far in the end, and this race is much less competitive; moves up in trip again; considered.

runners.breeder: S R L Az Agr Razza Della Sila
runners.comment: Lightly raced in recent years and needs addition of blinkers to aid a revival
runners.name: Fontana Ellissi
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced in recent years and remains without a win since 2022; always behind when 33-1 for seasonal debut at Lingfield (2m7f, soft) in December and needs addition of blinkers to aid a revival.

runners.comment: Made all for clearcut C&D success four weeks ago and is now 3-8 over hurdles
runners.name: Ferret Jeeter
runners.spotlight: Made all for clearcut C&D (soft) success four weeks ago and is now 3-8 over hurdles; also suited by good/good to soft ground and might still be on the upgrade; commands respect.

runners.comment: Ran well until tiring on heavy going last month; C&D win off 6lb higher on good last April
runners.name: All Authorized
runners.spotlight: Chasing did not go well this season (three runs) but he ran well until tiring on heavy ground over hurdles at Fontwell (2m5f, heavy) recently and is now 6lb lower than for an emphatic C&D win on good ground last April.

16:00.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before Cheltenham Dragonboosts Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Dominated at Market Rasen last month and should also be suited by this left-handed track
runners.name: Scottish King
runners.spotlight: Consistent since switched to chasing in the autumn and made all to score by 11l at Market Rasen (3m, soft) three weeks ago; should also be suited by this left-handed track and can make another bold bid.

runners.comment: Promising second on seasonal/chase debut but subsequent form has been disappointing
runners.name: Gata Ban
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner; kept on for second on seasonal/chase debut at Fakenham (2m5f, good to soft) in October and is now 7lb lower but her subsequent form has been disappointing; had wind op in January; needs to get career back on track.

runners.comment: Unreliable nowadays but won over C&D two starts ago and is still on a good mark
runners.name: Felton Bellevue
runners.owner: Mrs H Munn R E Good B Case
runners.spotlight: Five-time chase winner, most recently over C&D (soft) last month; remote when third at Huntingdon eight days ago and not one to rely upon nowadays but he's still on a good mark if in the right mood.

runners.comment: Low-mileage 7yo; well held over hurdles last time but second in C&D chase two starts ago
runners.name: Minella Kaiser
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who launched chasing career with two good efforts, latterly when second to Felton Bellevue over C&D (soft) in February; ran in snatches and was disappointing over hurdles here a fortnight ago but might travel better in first-time cheekpieces today and could still have potential over fences.

runners.comment: C&D winner in 2024 and took step back in the right direction over hurdles on latest outing
runners.name: Hilltown
runners.spotlight: Returned from a long layoff with some disappointing efforts this season but took a step back in the right direction over hurdles at Fontwell (3m2f, soft) in January, where he put in a good front-running shift before tiring; now 1lb lower than when winning comfortably by 13l over C&D (good) in April 2024 and enters calculations; cheekpieces (worn for last two races) removed.

runners.breeder: E A R L Les Obeaux DAnjou Et Al
runners.comment: Placed on all three hurdling starts and ought to be suited by this step up in trip
runners.name: Lasko Des Obeaux
runners.spotlight: Placed on Irish point debut last spring and on all three hurdling starts this season, most recently when third at Carlisle (2m1f, good to soft) last month; ought to be suited by today's move up in trip and should have some improvement to come in handicaps.

runners.comment: Ran well until tiring on soft ground last time; a possible if aided by new tongue-tie
runners.name: Valadon
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on seasonal debut but fared better when fourth (albeit tired and well held in the end) at Wincanton (2m4f, soft) in January and is now only 1lb higher than for last spring's Fontwell win (2m5f, good); contender if aided by new tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Lurks on a dangerous mark but has largely been disappointing this season
runners.name: Galactic Charm
runners.spotlight: Lurks on a dangerous mark and his defeat on heavy ground a fortnight ago is not viewed harshly but he's largely been disappointing this season and has stamina to prove over this new trip.

runners.comment: Absent since a poor run in November but has the form to feature if fully tuned up
runners.name: Baltray
runners.spotlight: 1-9 over hurdles; absent since a poor performance in November but the form of his second off today's mark at Stratford (2m6f, good; handles good to soft) two starts ago has been well advertised by the winner in the meantime; can feature if fully tuned up.

runners.comment: Has lost his way over fences; back hurdling with new headgear tried here
runners.name: Moon Hunter
runners.spotlight: Useful in his prime but left Henry Daly after a poor run over fences in February 2025 and was soundly beaten in two chases for this stable towards end of last year; needs combination of new headgear and return to hurdling to rekindle his enthusiasm.

runners.comment: No win since 2023 but form of penultimate run has worked out well; can't be ignored
runners.name: Balboa
runners.spotlight: Remote when third at Newbury (2m4f, soft) three weeks ago and remains winless since 2023 but the form of his keeping-on fourth at Taunton (2m3f, good) two starts ago has worked out well and he's too well handicapped to ignore.

runners.comment: Found 0-130 company too hot last time but looked progressive beforehand; major player
runners.name: Oakleys Way
runners.spotlight: Scored in first-time tongue tie at Taunton (2m3f, good to firm) in November, his second handicap, and also ran well when placed at Wincanton (1m7f, soft) on next outing; found 0-130 company slightly too hot at Kempton last time but remains unexposed over this sort of trip and may still have more to offer.

17:00.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before Cheltenham Welcome Offer Open National Hunt Flat Race (Cat 1 Elim) (GBB)

runners.comment: Down the field in Cork bumper last summer but has won an Irish point since; stable debut
runners.name: Mint Approved
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred 6yo; well down the field in Cork bumper last summer but won soft-ground Irish point in December and has possibilities on this British debut.

runners.comment: Runner-up on debut and not disgraced in a good race last time; leading contender
runners.name: Oties Friend
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut at Huntingdon (good to soft) in December and not discredited when midfield in good race at Kempton (good to soft) last month; sets a fair standard of rules form; leading contender.

runners.comment: Shaped quite well before fading into fourth of six at Lingfield (AW) in December
runners.name: Silk Mountain
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to smart jumper Castlegrace Paddy; shaped quite well before fading into fourth of six at Lingfield (AW; form boosted by winner since) in December but probably needs to build on that effort here.

runners.comment: Out of a well-connected mare; stable has a good strike-rate in bumpers
runners.name: Blues Secret Gem
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; dam unplaced over hurdles, half-sister to bumper winner Posh Paula, out of unraced half-sister to high-class staying hurdler Bannow Bay, Galway Plate winner Far From Trouble and smart staying jumper Mighty Moss; stable has good strike-rate in bumpers (19%).

runners.comment: Seemed to be running well until hanging left and losing position on home turn at Kempton
runners.name: Chocks Away
runners.owner: Wg Vestey Ag Vestey D Spencer Churchill
runners.spotlight: Out of unraced half-sister to smart hurdler Get Me Out Of Here; seemingly in the process of running well until hanging badly left and losing position on home turn at Kempton (good to soft; finished in midfield) last month; could have a say if more tractable here.

runners.comment: Half-brother to high-class jumper Any Second Now; with top stable; shortlisted
runners.name: Delgany Second Now
runners.spotlight: Eleventh foal; half-brother to high-class jumper Any Second Now and useful jumper Roxboro Road; dam placed in a bumper, sister to bumper/jumps winner New Time; with a top stable (20% strike-rate in bumpers); shortlisted.

runners.comment: Out of a German/Dutch Flat winner; stable not known for bumper success
runners.name: Shes A Driver
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to fair Flat/jumps winner Na Caith Tabac; dam German/Dutch Flat winner; stable not known for bumper success.

14:20.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before Cheltenham Extra Places Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won at Warwick in November and was third in a Listed contest at Musselburgh last time.
runners.name: Scarlet Moon
runners.spotlight: Won four times on the Flat up to 1m6f and got off the mark over hurdles on his second start at Warwick (2m, good) in November; has continued to run well since, running his best race when third in a Listed contest at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in January; should have no issues with the step up in trip and sets the standard.

runners.comment: Won three times at an ordinary level on the Flat; hurdles debut.
runners.name: Both Of Us
runners.owner: Mrs H Watson & Mrs Carol Lee
runners.spotlight: His autumn progress on the Flat for George Boughey came at an ordinary level but he won three times (1m4f/2m) and there's every chance he'll make a hurdler; not ruled out on first run since changing hands for 20,000gns.

runners.comment: Made a winning hurdles debut at Warwick in December; creditable second since; had wind op.
runners.name: Cloaks Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Failed to win from six attempts on the Flat but made a winning hurdles debut against her own sex at Warwick (2m, good to soft) in December; creditable second at Wetherby (2m, soft) the following month; has had wind surgery since and should run well.

runners.comment: Pulled his chance away on his stable/hurdles debut at Fontwell in November.
runners.name: Forever Penywern
runners.spotlight: Landed a couple of sellers on the Flat for William Haggas last August/September; pulled his chance away in a first-time hood (retained) on his stable/hurdles debut at Fontwell (2m1f, good to soft; 100-30) in November; in good hands and should know more this time.

runners.comment: Always behind when eighth of ten on debut in bumper at Hereford last month.
runners.name: Jersey Tex
runners.spotlight: Always behind when eighth of ten on debut in bumper at Hereford (2m, soft) last month; first start over hurdles and looks one for the future.

runners.comment: Runner-up on both hurdle starts, latest when beaten a neck at Newbury ten days ago.
runners.name: Love You Back
runners.spotlight: Won on the Flat at Brighton in September; has taken well to hurdling, finishing runner-up on both starts, latest when beaten a neck at Newbury (2m, good to soft; 5-2) ten days ago; looks a matter of time before he gets his head in front in this sphere.

14:50.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before BOG @ Cheltenham Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Showed he was no back number when second at Leicester 13 days ago.
runners.name: Xcitations
runners.owner: G LibsonD BaylissT Davies & P Sly
runners.spotlight: Grand servant for the yard with eight wins (six over fences); showed he was no back number when second of four in returning cheekpieces (left off here) at Leicester (2m, soft) 13 days ago; should run his race.

runners.comment: Won twice for Dan Skelton but showed little for current yard in three starts last year.
runners.name: In This World
runners.spotlight: Won twice for Dan Skelton but showed little for current yard in three starts last year; hard to fancy.

runners.breeder: S A R L De Chambure Haras DEtreham
runners.comment: Won over hurdles in December but yet to get off the mark over fences after seven attempts.
runners.name: Non Stop
runners.spotlight: Landed his fourth success over hurdles at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft) in December but yet to get off the mark in this sphere after seven attempts; beaten 30l when third of four finishers at Plumpton (2m1f, soft) four weeks ago; has had wind surgery since and needs to step up.

runners.comment: Third on his second start over fences at Southwell last month.
runners.name: Gaelic Rambler
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two Irish points in 2024 and yet to get his head in front under rules; shaped better when dropped in trip and third of five finishers on his second start over fences at Southwell (2m4f, soft) last month but it remains to be seen if this even shorter trip is the answer.

runners.comment: Won over hurdles in May but yet to finish in front of a rival in three starts over fences.
runners.name: Cobblers Boy
runners.spotlight: Scored over hurdles in May but hasn't finished in front of a rival in three starts over fences; his handicap mark continues to plummet and no surprise were his top yard find the key at some point.

runners.breeder: Philippe Ouvry & Ecurie Des Vives Terres
runners.comment: Dual winner over fences but last success was three years ago.
runners.name: Grey Diamond
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over fences but last success was three years ago; his mark continues to fall but he doesn't look ready to take advantage.

runners.comment: Won third chase (Market Rasen; 2m1f, good) in August off 2lb higher mark; well held since.
runners.name: Harel Du Marais
runners.spotlight: Landed his third chase success when winning at Market Rasen (2m1f, good) in August off a 2lb higher mark; well held since, including a couple of spins over hurdles, and it could be that a return to fences brings out the best in him.

runners.comment: Pulled up following a lengthy break at Ludlow in January and makes chasing/handicap debut.
runners.name: Ironica De Thaix
runners.spotlight: Won a French bumper in 2021 but has been rarely seen since and best effort in Britain came when making a promising start for this stable, finishing an 11.5l third of eight at Ffos Las (2m4f, heavy) in February 2024 after an absence; pulled up following another lengthy break at Ludlow in January and makes chasing/handicap debut; seemingly not easy to train but a market watch is advised.

15:20.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before Cheltenham Infernoboosts Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Two Mile Hdl Qual)

runners.comment: Won this from 3lb lower in 2024; ran creditably at Windsor (2m Class 2; fifth) in January.
runners.name: Milldam
runners.spotlight: Won this from 3lb lower in 2024; ran creditably at Windsor (2m Class 2; fifth, 20-1) in January but pulled up in a premier handicap at Newbury subsequently; drying ground wouldn't play to his strengths.

runners.comment: Disappointed - unsuited by heavy ground - at Newbury (pulled up) latest; ample potential.
runners.name: Let It Rain
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner, also landing the odds in a mares' novice at Wetherby (2m) in November 2024; fine effort (third) on handicap debut at Ascot (2m) in December but she disappointed - unsuited by heavy ground - at Newbury (pulled up, 5-2 favourite) latest; still ample potential.

runners.comment: Fourth to Constitution Hill at Southwell latest; back to hurdles needing a career best
runners.name: Mr McLoughlan
runners.spotlight: Notched third win over hurdles on handicap debut at Huntingdon (2m Class 4; from 5lb lower) in November; ran too free when finishing down the field at Musselburgh on New Years' Day; fourth to Constitution Hill on Southwell Flat latest; back to hurdles needing a career best.

runners.comment: Last win at Newcastle (2m1f Class 3; from 2lb higher) 11 months ago; 0-4 over fences since
runners.name: Anyharminasking
runners.spotlight: 3-20 hurdles, his latest win at Newcastle (2m1f Class 3; from 2lb higher) 11 months ago; a switch to fences hasn't suited (0-4, including being beaten in a match) but it's possible he'll strip fitter since his latest start; reverting to the smaller obstacles is helpful.

runners.comment: Last of three over fences at Sandown (2m4f; beaten 42l) on Saturday; a quick turnaround.
runners.name: Here Comes Georgie
runners.spotlight: Narrow winner at Perth (2m Class 2, good) from 2lb lower for Patrick Neville last August; campaigned exclusively over fences (with mixed fortunes) since joining this trainer; last of three at Sandown (2m4f, soft; beaten 42l) on Saturday; this is a quick turnaround.

runners.comment: Won first two for this trainer; tailed off in a Cheltenham Grade 2 (40-1) latest; possible
runners.name: Adonedeal
runners.spotlight: Won a Southwell maiden (2m, soft) on first start for this trainer, before adding to his tally in a weak Plumpton novice (1-12 favourite); tailed off in a Grade 2 at Cheltenham (40-1) latest; drops back in trip for handicap debut, with headgear removed; a possible player.

runners.comment: Runner-up at Plumpton (2m; form franked) latest; this opening mark looks fair.
runners.name: Looping dArc
runners.owner: Mrs J Fowler & Mrs T Brown
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start over hurdles at Southwell (2m maiden) in December; blotted copybook by running out at Hereford next time; runner-up when  evens at Plumpton (2m novice; winner successful since) latest; opening mark (handicap debut) looks fair; must enter calculations.

runners.comment: Won a Leicester seller (2m4f) on penultimate start; 2m fine but this is a tough task.
runners.name: Casa Loupi
runners.spotlight: Didn't jump with fluency but took advantage of ease in grade to justify favouritism in a Leicester seller (2m4f, soft) on penultimate start; toiled back in a handicap (Class 4) at Lingfield latest; this is a tough task, even if returning to this shorter trip may suit.

runners.comment: Afforded run of race when easy winner at Catterick (2m) latest; now 8lb higher in Class 3.
runners.name: Comanche Magic
runners.spotlight: Heading in the right direction (RPRs 98, 104, and 115) since joining Stuart Edmunds, afforded the run of the race when an easy winner at Catterick (2m Class 4, soft; 9-2) latest; steps up in grade from an 8lb higher mark; a noteworthy candidate around this sharp track.

runners.comment: Runner-up at Fakenham (2m Class 4) latest; more required off 11-week absence.
runners.name: Sleeping Late
runners.spotlight: Yet to win (0-6) but he ran his best race yet when second at Fakenham (2m Class 4, soft; 6-1) on latest start; competes from the same mark on return from an 11-week absence; needs to his raise game further in this more competitive contest.

runners.comment: Latest Lingfield effort a slight step backwards; goes handicapping in competitive contest
runners.name: Unjeu Royal
runners.spotlight: Debut bumper winner; hampered by a loose horse on hurdles debut, prior to finding one stronger in a Huntingdon maiden (2m; 5-4 favourite, lugged left); latest Lingfield effort was a slight step backwards and this looks a competitive contest in which to make handicap debut; others preferred.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Du Fosse Blanc
runners.comment: Two stinkers since winning a Warwick novice (2m) last September; handicap mark is easing.
runners.name: Soleil dArizona
runners.spotlight: Made short work of opposition at Warwick (2m novice, good; 4-11) in September but has turned in two stinkers - ran freely at Kempton, always behind at Ludlow - since after an absence; handicap mark is easing; drying ground is a positive.

runners.comment: 2-7 for trainer; won penultimate start; latest may have come too soon (2m, heavy; 4-7)
runners.name: Morning Mayhem
runners.spotlight: Won twice since joining Nick Scholfield, comfortably justifying favouritism at Fakenham (2m Class 5, soft; from 7lb lower) on penultimate start; might have simply found the race coming too soon in tough conditions at Ffos Las (2m, heavy; third) latest; moves up in grade.

runners.comment: Still early days but this represents a tough handicap debut off a 174-day absence.
runners.name: Woodview Lad
runners.spotlight: Showed ability for Gordon Elliott, finishing third on Cork debut (2m maiden, soft; 14-1); remote fourth on first start for this trainer at Uttoxeter last September; still early days but this represents a tough handicap debut off a 174-day absence.

15:50.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before Cheltenham Dragonboosts Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Placed at Southwell (6-4 fav) when last seen over three months ago; stays 2m6f; key player
runners.name: Ballyhiho
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough in a newly applied tongue-tie at Worcester (2m4f, good; from 12l lower) last August; narrowly beaten back there next time and placed at Southwell (6-4 favourite) when last seen over three months ago; stays 2m6f, and the forecast drying conditions promise to suit; key player.

runners.comment: Runner-up on handicap debut at Chepstow (2m4f; beaten nearly 10l); something to build on.
runners.name: Harbour Light
runners.spotlight: Modest in maiden/novice events (1m7f-2m) but better when stepping up in trip for handicap debut at Chepstow recently (2m4f, soft; runner-up, beaten nearly 10l); there's still time to brush up his jumping technique and, on pedigree, he should handle this extra yardage; chance.

runners.comment: Hasn't kicked on over hurdles (0-4), pulling up on handicap debut at Hereford (2m4f, soft)
runners.name: Noble Grace
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut in a Cheltenham bumper (2m1f, good; beaten a neck, 14-1) last April; hasn't kicked on positively over hurdles (0-4), pulling up on handicap debut at Hereford (2m4f; soft) two months ago; now sits 3lb lower.

runners.comment: Beaten 42l, 78l and 83l in 2m maiden/novice events; focus elsewhere.
runners.name: Colby Mayfield
runners.spotlight: Beaten 42l, 78l and 83l in a trio of 2m maiden/novice events at Exeter, Newbury, and Chepstow; tackles a new trip - some plus points on pedigree - for handicap debut; far better to focus elsewhere.

runners.breeder: S C E A De Maulepaire
runners.comment: Newcastle winner (2m4f) in January; cheekpieces fitted from 4lb higher mark; thereabouts.
runners.name: Cher Monsieur
runners.spotlight: Displayed a willing attitude when off the mark at the eighth attempt at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft; 11-4 favourite) nearly two months ago; subsequent 4lb rise looks fair; fitted with cheekpieces (has worn a hood in the past) and back up in trip; likely to be thereabouts.

runners.comment: Beaten 36l in a 1m7f maiden at Wincanton (heavy; 150-1) six weeks ago; unlikely candidate.
runners.name: Galactic Princess
runners.spotlight: Beaten 36l in a 1m7f maiden at Wincanton (heavy; 150-1) six weeks ago; steps up in trip for handicap debut; this is a thin-looking contest but she still rates an unlikely candidate.

runners.comment: Sent off at a whopping 300-1 in a 2m4f Ffos Las maiden (beaten 66l) latest; lowly rated.
runners.name: Eaststone Bucks
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on debut here (2m2f) a year ago, and sent off at a whopping 300-1 in a 2m4f Ffos Las maiden (beaten 66l) latest; trainer is having an uncharacteristically quiet season; lowly rated handicap debutant, stablemate of Lily Grace.

runners.comment: Tailed off on heavy ground at Exeter (2m) latest; makes handicap debut at a suitable level
runners.name: Miss Jaffa Cake
runners.spotlight: In the process of outrunning odds when unseating her rider at the third-last at Wincanton (2m5f mares' novice; 250-1) on penultimate start; tailed off on heavy ground at Exeter (2m) subsequently; makes handicap debut at a suitable level; isn't a forlorn hope.

runners.comment: Tailed off on handicap debut at Hereford (2m5f) just over a fortnight ago; unappealing.
runners.name: Lily Grace
runners.spotlight: Nothing positive so far, beaten 58l when earning a 'peak' RPR of 53 at Warwick (2m3f mares' novice; 250-1) in January; tailed off on handicap debut at Hereford (2m5f) just over a fortnight ago.

runners.comment: 0-7; looks very limited in terms of ability; the least likely candidate.
runners.name: Dont Cheddar Tear
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in three of first four starts and weakened tamely on both starts (massive odds) since a 445-day absence; looks very limited in terms of ability; handicap debut but the least likely candidate.

16:20.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before Cheltenham Welcome Offer Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Got off the mark in this sphere in a match at Plumpton four weeks ago.
runners.name: Star Of Affinity
runners.spotlight: Won three times over hurdles and got off the mark in this sphere in a match at Plumpton (2m4f, soft) four weeks ago; up 4lb and difficult to evaluate but on an upward curve and one to be interested in.

runners.comment: May not have got home when last of four finishers at Doncaster (3m, soft) last month.
runners.name: As Legends Have It
runners.spotlight: Yet to build on his bumper success in April 2024 but was still in contention when falling four out at Wetherby (3m, soft) in December and may not have got home when last of four finishers at Doncaster (3m, soft) the following month; drops back down in trip and is not out of this.

runners.comment: Yet to get off the mark in this sphere in three attempts but has shown distinct promise.
runners.name: Batwomen
runners.spotlight: Both wins over hurdles came at Fontwell; yet to get off the mark in this sphere in three attempts but has shown distinct promise; has had wind surgery since last of three finishers at Huntingdon (2m7f, soft) in January and may warrant another chance.

runners.comment: Won at Fontwell in November and good third at Cheltenham subsequently.
runners.name: Realta Liath
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start over fences at Fontwell (2m3f, good to soft) in November and ran well when third of 13 finishers at Cheltenham (2m4f, good to soft) the following month; had an off day at Market Rasen last time but worth another chance.

runners.comment: Landed his first British success at Wincanton last month with something in hand.
runners.name: Jeu dOpale
runners.spotlight: Won 2m2f chase in France in 2022 but missed 2023 and 2024; landed his first British success at Wincanton (2m4f, heavy) last month with something in hand and must come into the equation off 9lb higher.

runners.comment: Yet to recapture best form in two runs following a year's absence.
runners.name: Noche Negra
runners.spotlight: Jumped well when scoring on his stable debut at Warwick (2m4f, soft) in late 2024 but he hasn't recaptured that form in two runs following a year's absence, latterly when found to have an irregular heartbeat back at Warwick in January; cheekpieces back on but risky at present.

runners.comment: 0-16 and has failed to complete in three starts over fences.
runners.name: Streamsforth Lad
runners.spotlight: 0-16 but has shown bits of form over hurdles; has failed to complete in three starts over fences, latest when unseated early on at Southwell (3m, soft) in first-time cheekpieces (retained); not one to give up on but comes with risks.

runners.comment: Won twice in the autumn for Olly Murphy but below that level at Warwick twice since.
runners.name: Pescatorius
runners.spotlight: In good form for Olly Murphy in the autumn, winning in blinkers at Sedgefield (3m2f, good to firm) and Market Rasen (2m5f, good to soft), but soundly beaten in cheekpieces (retained) at Warwick for new stable twice since and now has a point to prove.
